test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Motor Vehicle) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following processes is used to fit a bearing into the connecting rod, allowing the gudgeon pin to provide the oscillating movement at the small end of the connecting rod?
solution:
The correct answer is __Press fit__.

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• A press fit__ is a fastening between two parts that is achieved by friction after the parts are pushed together.
 
• This type of fit is used to secure the bearing into the connecting rod and allows the gudgeon pin to oscillate smoothly.
 
• Press fits are commonly used in assemblies where high strength and reliability are required.
 
• The process involves applying force to fit the bearing into its housing with precise interference.
 
• It ensures no slippage between the bearing and the connecting rod, maintaining the operational integrity of the mechanism.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Loose Fit:**

 
 
• Loose fits are used when parts need to move freely relative to each other.
 
• It is not suitable for applications requiring precise alignment or load transmission.
 
 
 
• **Interference Fit:**
 
 
• Interference fits involve a larger component being pressed into a slightly smaller hole.
 
• They are used when a very strong and permanent fit is required.
 
 
 
• **Autofrettage Fit:**
 
 
• Autofrettage is a process used to strengthen pressure-containing components by inducing residual compressive stresses.
 
• It is not typically related to the assembly of bearings and connecting rods.
